newsitem.title: SYRIA: Radical Palestinians condemn Israeli violence.
newsitem.headline: Radical Palestinians condemn Israeli violence.

text.p: Radical Palestinian groups led thousands of people at a refugee camp near Damascus in a protest on Sunday against Israel's opening of a tunnel near holy sites in Jerusalem.
Men, women and children in Yarmouk Camp condemned Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and vowed to avenge the deaths of 55 Palestinians killed in clashes with the Israeli army last week.
Shops were closed while demonstrators carried white banners reading "We are ready to pay the price for Jerusalem" and burned the Israeli flag.
Islamic Jihad, the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine and the Democratic Front for the Liberation of Palestine are among the 10 members of the Damascus-based alliance of radical factions.
"We urge all Arab countries to cut their diplomatic ties with Israel and halt all forms of normalisation," Maher al-Taher of the PFLP said in a statement after the demonstration.
"And in light of these dangerous developments we call for an Arab summit to take a practical and clear action to support the Palestinian struggle," he added.
Clashes began last Tuesday when Israel opened a tunnel near Jerusalem's al Aqsa Mosque, but Netanyahu said on Sunday the tunnel would remain open.
